**Finding: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The document contains no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction:

- **Article 3 (Fees; Payment)** is the only commercial-terms article. Section 3.1 fixes a flat 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold; Sections 3.2–3.4 cover payment timing, quarterly reconciliation and HDI's audit right (at HDI's own cost). Nothing obliges the Company to extend to HDI any better pricing or terms granted to third parties, and nothing requires us to match a third-party offer.
- Targeted searches for *most favored*, *no less favorable*, *favorable*, *price*, *discount*, *match* and *refusal* returned no hits.
- **Section 6.1 (Exclusivity)** does restrain the Company from similar internet projects for Deerskin Products and grants HDI exclusive use of the "Deerskin" brand for a consumer web site, but that is a scope/exclusivity restraint, not an obligation to give HDI terms no less favourable than those given to others — so it falls outside this rule (it may warrant attention under an exclusivity rule instead).

This matches the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no edit is warranted.
